checks.ref: command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh; if grep -n '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "the tasks listed above are open again - the fix-code stage must leave tasks.md as implement left it"; exit 1; fi

command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-code#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
outside=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep . | grep -E -v '^(packages/client/|docs/)' | grep -vxF "$reports/review-code.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
outside=$(printf '%s\n' "$outside" $(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep '^docs/adr/') | grep . || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the fix-code stage edits only packages/client/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, $reports/handoff/ and the resolutions in $reports/review-code.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-code#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$reports/review-code.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 fix forks an existing helper instead of extending it: packages/client/src/test/features/main_page/steps/main_page_readme_screenshots_e2e.steps.ts:7-21 redefines `const OFFLINE_NOTICE_WAIT_MS = 1500;` (already at time_selection/steps/timeSelectionE2eHelpers.ts:17), hardcodes `const RUSSIAN_DISMISS_NAME = "Закрыть";` (the `app.dismiss` text of src/locales/ru.json, while the helper reads `englishLocale.app.dismiss`), and repeats the helper's click-with-timeout-then-ignore logic. .claude/rules/glossary.md: "If the owner does not fit the need, change the owner and its tests, so the concept keeps one home. Do not fork it into a near-copy." .claude/rules/code-style.md: "Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant". It also makes every README screenshot run wait out a 1.5 s timeout on the button of the other language. Fix: give dismissOfflineReadyNotice the dismiss name (or the locale) as a parameter and pass `app.dismiss` from the locale of the scenario's language, instead of keeping a second copy in the step file.

findings.message: R4 is rejected as 'not-worth-it' ('coverage gap only, no live defect … for a hypothetical future regression'), but the gap is an untested requirement of this change. proposal.md:88 NFR-A1 says: 'With the menu open above its button or with a limited height … At the centre of every menu item that is inside the menu's visible box, the topmost element is that item.' .claude/rules/test-planning.md says: 'Every FR/NFR/UX from proposal must have at least one automated test covering it.' No test checks that the topmost element at each item's centre is that item for a menu opened above its button or with a limited height. The 'No accessibility violations with the menu opened above' outline (packages/client/src/test/features/locations/locations_menu_placement_e2e.feature:98-116) runs axe-core only, and locations_menu_placement_e2e.steps.ts has no topmost step. The fix is cheap: add a step such as 'every menu item has that menu item on top' that calls the existing isTopmostAt (grid_view/steps/hourGridE2eHelpers.ts) at the centre of each menuitem inside the menu's visible box, and use it in the opened-above outline and in the limited-height outline (:63). The rejection dodges a real, cheap-to-fix defect.

The same NFR-A1 topmost check is also narrower than the delta spec in the date-bar scenario: specs/locations/spec.md:77 requires 'at the centre of every item of the menu the topmost element is that item', but locations_menu_placement_e2e.feature:90 only asserts 'every menu item over the date bar has that menu item on top'. The step proposed for R4 would close this too.
